ostrzezenia.tekst: According to FDA, for recipes that call for eggs that are raw or undercooked when the dish is served, use shell eggs treated to destroy Salmonella, by pasteurization or another approved method, or pasteurized egg products. [T:SUS-333]

akapity: Rutgers Cooperative Extension crystallizes edible flowers by brushing them with egg white or powdered egg whites and sprinkling them with sugar. [T:SUS-334]
The fresh egg white in this method is not cooked, so the FDA advice on pasteurized eggs or pasteurized egg products applies to it. [T:SUS-333,SUS-334]
The Rutgers method is for edible flowers, not for leaves. [T:SUS-334]
JarAtlas has found no tested source for candied mint or sage leaves. [T:-]
